scope: CPU-only recomputation from existing summary.json, manifest.json, states.jsonl; no training, GPU, evaluation or direction regeneration

metric_definition.positive_damage_average: G_m,s(r) = (1/100) sum_k max(D_m,s(r,u_k),0) for r>0; G(0)=0
metric_definition.absolute_relation: absolute_loss_mean = own_anchor_loss + D_mean; generally not own_anchor_loss + G
metric_definition.epsilon: User-specified allowable G threshold, not a per-radius measured metric; saved thresholds [.001,.005,.01,.02,.05]
metric_definition.prefix_tolerance: R_grid(epsilon) = max{r_j: max_{i<=j} G(r_i) <= epsilon}; all r_j in {0,.25,...,20}
metric_definition.units: CE in nats per example; radius is effective-Q/V Euclidean/Frobenius perturbation norm

direction_checks.note: Actual logged direction hashes/norms checked in every raw state. Direction tensors are not serialized here, so this audit does not independently rehash tensor arrays; source code confirms hashes are computed from generated tensors before measurement. Empty manifest.actual_direction_sha256 concerns actual-drift directions, so public random directions were checked in states.jsonl.point.direction.

plot_recommendation.fourth_panel: Training-side exact discrete-grid inverse staircase for epsilon from 0 to .05
plot_recommendation.algorithm: Take running maximum of the 81 G values per seed; use union of all running-maximum values as epsilon breakpoints; inverse via searchsorted(side=right)-1; right-continuous post steps; average seed-specific radii only after inversion when a three-seed mean is intended.
plot_recommendation.right_censoring: R=20 means scan cap/lower bound >=20, not proven equality of the unrestricted radius. All six training runs are right-censored at epsilon=.05. If a mean curve contains a censored seed, that aggregate includes censored components.
plot_recommendation.grid_limit: Exact for recorded radius grid only; does not certify every real-valued intermediate radius or unobserved directions.
plot_recommendation.saved_thresholds: The five saved epsilon values are validated checkpoints, not the only thresholds inferable from the complete G(r) grid. Do not linearly connect only these five values.
plot_recommendation.smoothing: No spline or linear interpolation of tolerance between breakpoints.

interpretation.test_baseline_explanation: GAM begins at a lower own-anchor CE and increases more at r=20, while remaining lower in absolute mean CE. This is an algebraic explanation of compatible metrics, not evidence that the lower baseline causally produces greater damage.
interpretation.Fisher_distinction: Dense G uses only forward CE evaluations; it is not empirical Fisher trace or a normalized Fisher surrogate. Empirical Fisher elsewhere is mean per-example gradient outer product; this audit cannot establish a causal mechanism connecting it to G.
interpretation.sampling_limit: 100 matched sampled directions support finite directional-average comparisons, not worst-case robustness or exact uniform-sphere expectation.
